editorial:
Imagine being so angry that you would throw your own life away just to get a shot at the person who ruined everything. That is exactly what happens here. You follow a tough detective who cannot let go of the pain after his wife was killed. Since the murderer is locked up for life, the detective does something crazy: he commits a crime on purpose to get sent to the same prison. It is a gritty, mean-spirited ride that feels like a pressure cooker. You can tell right away that this is not a movie about forgiveness; it is all about a man who wants to make someone suffer as much as he does.

The fight scenes are brutal and feel very real, which keeps you on the edge of your seat. While the plot is pretty simple, the acting makes you believe in the rage. Some parts might feel a bit too dark or slow, but the payoff is worth it. If you love revenge stories, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, the detective finally tracks down the man who killed his wife. After a long and bloody fight, he gets his revenge and kills the criminal. However, the twist is that the detective has lost his own soul in the process. He gets what he wanted, but he is left completely broken and empty. He does not find peace; he only finds the cold reality that killing the man did not bring his wife back.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark revenge thrillers and gritty prison movies.
